main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move (return minus coin's mean daily return) over bars with forecast > 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2.0 and slope > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2.0; else inconclusive; fewer than 30 distinct days: inconclusive

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of next-day unusual move on forecast

decided_by: The t lies between -2.0 and 2.0 (or cannot be computed), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: The situation is checked as close < min(low of prior 20 bars) (raw depth value < 0, recomputed from prices where not recorded) on the long side, without re-testing the choppy profile the code adds; the next-day return of a window's last bar is left out; the day-clustered t sums the cases' deviations per UTC day with a D/(D-1) correction; the plan's own 'fewer than 30 distinct days' rule is treated as the minimum count and reported as not observable.
